guides.favoredWhen: Mordekaiser wins by landing Q on commits and pushing off jumps; Jax wins if he baits the pull and stacks extended trades.

keyTips.text: When Jax jumps onto you, use E to push him away and deny the stun follow-up. His whole engage depends on sticking after the leap, and the displacement breaks it.
keyTips.heading: Jump answer

keyTips.text: Land Q when he commits; missing it makes the fight far worse. The all-in hinges on the Q hit, so only take committed trades with it ready to fire.
keyTips.heading: Q discipline

keyTips.text: Activate your ultimate after his, never before. His R up first limits what your realm steals, so let him commit his before taking him down.
keyTips.heading: Ult order

tips.text: At level 1, farm with Q from range without pushing the wave. Contest nothing early; the matchup starts once your full pattern is online.
tips.heading: Level 1

tips.text: After level 2, do not walk up for farm if it exposes you to his trade. Give the cs rather than the health, then retake control with three abilities unlocked.
tips.heading: Level 2 respect

tips.text: Take short trades while the wave sits near your turret. The short window plus tower safety is your pattern; his extended stickiness is his.
tips.heading: Short trades

tips.text: From level 4, all-in only with Q landing first. The committed fight is yours when Q connects and his when it misses, so check the hit before staying.
tips.heading: All-in rule

tips.text: If he sticks to you for an extended early trade, pull him off with E. His damage needs contact time, and each peel resets his stack-up.
tips.heading: Peel rule

tips.text: Deny him short trades and you likely win the all-in. Force the committed fight on landed Q rather than trading his short pattern.
tips.heading: Fight selection

tips.text: If even or ahead after level 6, press the advantage. The matchup eases from that spot, so convert the realm window before he finds an item answer.
tips.heading: Post-6 press
